text.card: A red giant 1,544 parsecs away, 18 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.05 solar masses and 18.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,327 K at its surface.
